name: Cyberpunk
_comment: Cyberpunk 2077 livery: 2077 yellow on a flat hot-red ground. The background is deliberately dead - no gradient, grid, rays, motes, scanbar, scanlines or vignette - so the only thing moving is the name, which glitches every couple of seconds. Set in caps in a technical face.

font._comment: Orbitron and Rajdhani are the real 2077-adjacent faces; install either and it wins. Bahnschrift (DIN, ships with Windows) is the fallback that is actually present. uppercase draws every name in caps.

background._comment: Everything off - the panel is a flat fill of bg_bottom and nothing draws on top of it.

glitch._comment: Every period_ms, the name tears for duration_ms: colour-fringed ghosts thrown either side, then the name redrawn in sliced offsets.
